rateNote: 60 frames per second, not 24. A real pass at 6 m per second crosses the whole reachable span in two frames at 24, and the largest elbow change between frames falls from 9.4 degrees at 24 to 4.4 at 60. Nothing about the movement changes with the rate; there were not enough frames to hold it.
notes: The distinguishing feature of this drill is what does NOT happen. The manual says to pass the ball straight back to the passer without pulling it to the body, so there is no pull-in key. The hands stay out in front throughout.

keys.name: ready
keys.note: Showing the passer the arm span, same start as the pull-in drill.

keys.name: contact
keys.note: Contact in front of the shoulder.

keys.name: control
keys.note: Just enough give to control the ball. The hands stay out in front, they do not come to the body.

keys.name: return
keys.note: Straight back to the passer from where the ball was caught.
